general_background.title: Solvent choice follows the surface coating
general_background.summary: Chloroform can disperse many nanocrystals coated with organic ligands after colloidal growth. This dispersibility reflects the particle surface and does not establish that the crystalline core dissolved.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Prospects of Colloidal Nanocrystals for Electronic and Optoelectronic Applications

general_background.title: Methanol and ligand-coated particles
general_background.summary: In a size-selective precipitation, methanol can reduce the dispersing power of a nonpolar solvent for particles bearing hydrocarbon ligands. Which fraction precipitates depends on particle size and the surface coating, as well as the solvent mixture.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Synthesis and characterization of nearly monodisperse CdE (E = sulfur, selenium, tellurium) semiconductor nanocrystallites

general_background.title: Stable cluster intermediates can delay particle growth
general_background.summary: In some indium phosphide routes, unusually stable molecular clusters accumulate instead of turning immediately into a smoothly growing distribution. Their appearance breaks the simple link between mixing the precursor and forming the final nanocrystals.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

reference.title: Two-Step Nucleation and Growth of InP Quantum Dots via Magic-Sized Cluster Intermediates
